first.rationale: I intend to simplify onboarding because completion and activation are both declining, and the inherited evidence directly links shorter onboarding and fewer signup fields to durable improvements in early activation and time-to-value. This addresses the current funnel weakness without introducing discount-driven risks to long-term qualified revenue. I will verify both closely related onboarding records before committing, then run a measured experiment with activation, qualified conversion, retention, and downstream revenue guardrails.

final.rationale: Run a standard, segment-aware onboarding simplification experiment this week, prioritizing the shortened flow and testing reduced signup fields primarily for SMBs. The shortened flow improved completion, time-to-value, and 30-day retention, directly addressing both current declines. Signup simplification improved SMB activation and qualified revenue but slightly reduced retention and was not validated outside SMB, so retain segment limits and guardrails for activation, qualified revenue, 30-day retention, and downstream conversion.
